messages:
Elena P: Starting bring-up for visibility pipeline in eu-central-1 for the new GPU cluster (gpu-pool-02). Need to validate logs->s3, metrics->prom, traces->tempo. Also need 3 dashboards (cluster-health, GPU-util, ingress-latency) and alert templates. Who can own which piece?

Ravi K: I'll own logs ingestion. Plan: Fluent Bit on nodes -> kinesis/firehose -> s3 (raw) -> optional indexing to ES. Need IAM role for fluent-bit and an S3 bucket with lifecycle 30d->glacier. Any objections to 7d hot retention to save cost?

Mike L: I'll do Prometheus & Grafana dashboards. Will spin node-exporter + nvidia-dcgm exporter on GPU nodes. Suggest scrape_interval 30s for GPU metrics, 60s for node. Will commit dashboards to repo under monitoring/gpu-clusters.

Jen S: I'll handle tracing: deploy OpenTelemetry collector as a DaemonSet + Tempo backend. We'll sample at 1% initially, capture 10k traces/day cap. Need service account and KMS key for tempo S3 encryption.

infra-bot: deployment pipeline triggered: visibility-bootstrap-job started for cluster gpu-pool-02.

Elena P: Quick config snippet for prom scrape (for reference):
```yaml
- job_name: 'nvidia_dcgm'
  kubernetes_sd_configs:
  - role: pod
  relabel_configs:
  - source_labels: [__meta_kubernetes_pod_label_app]
    regex: 'dcgm-exporter'
    action: keep
  scrape_interval: 30s
```

Ravi K: For Fluent Bit config I'll push a minimal filter set:
```bash
[FILTER]
    Name                kubernetes
    Match               kube.*
    Merge_Log           On
```
Also need to set buffer limits for high throughput.

Mike L: Alerts draft:
- gpu_node_down: node_down for >5m -> severity=critical
- gpu_util_high: avg(gpu_utilization{job=~"nvidia.*"}[5m]) > 90% -> severity=warning
- prometheus_remote_write_fail -> severity=critical

Jen S: Traces alert template: high tail latency (p95 > 3s across model-serving namespace) -> pager.

Elena P: Cost note — logs retention @30d estimated $X/month for this cluster; if we drop to 7d hot + 90d cold it's ~60% cheaper. Ops decision needed.

Ravi K: I'll create the S3 bucket and lifecycle policy. Assigning the bucket write permission to fluent-bit role: infra-team to approve.

Mike L: I'll create initial dashboards, add to PR, and set up provisioning via grafana-operator. Will include variables for cluster and job.

Jen S: Handoff: once dashboards and alerts in PR, tag @oncall to validate during next maintenance window. Document runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/visibility-pipeline-euc1

Elena P: Tasks + owners: logs=Ravi, metrics=Mike, traces=Jen, infra provisioning=Infra Eng. ETA: end of week. Any blockers?

devops-runner: kube manifests applied: prometheus-operator v0.61 deployed, otel-collector v0.54 deployed.

Ravi K: one blocker — need a KMS key in eu-central-1 for tempo S3 encryption. @Security Team can we expedite?

Security Team: noted. Creating key, ETA 24h.

Elena P: Great. I'll pull these into the visibility provisioning runbook and mark handoff to SRE once Security confirms KMS. Thanks all :thumbsup:
